verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents on-robot capture of sensor and telemetry data: rosbag recording via the CLI and a Python API, plus topic statistics published as metrics. Nothing in the evidence shows a cloud sync mechanism or bandwidth-aware upload policies. The QoS settings for non-ideal networks are a node-to-node communication control, not a cloud sync policy, so they are not credited. missing for 10: cloud upload/sync capability, bandwidth-aware or prioritized sync policies, independent corroboration of an on-robot-to-cloud pipeline.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture sensor and telemetry data on-robot and sync it to the cloud with bandwidth-aware policies

citations.quote: This allows you to subscribe to a topic and save the received data to a bag at the same time as performing any other processing of your choice on that data.
The topic interface is meant for continuous data streams, for example, streaming sensor data or the status of your robot.
When you enable topic statistics for a subscription, ROS publishes the collected data at regular intervals as a MetricsMessage on a statistics topic.
